target_customer: Banks, retailers and financial companies in Latin America that need digital onboarding and loan origination
problem: Latin American banks run slow, paper heavy loan origination and account opening. Digi sells white-label software that gives them a fintech style flow.
business_model: B2B SaaS for financial institutions, white label, with modules for scoring, biometrics, e-signature and APIs
product_category: Loan origination and digital onboarding software for banks

founders.name: Santiago Pezzoni
previous_startups: Digiventures, platform connecting underbanked consumers with financial institutions in Argentina and Uruguay (per UC Berkeley 2020 article), which appears to be the predecessor of Digi
founders.background_notes: YC page says Evolution Partners is a McKinsey spin-off.

founders.name: Hernan Lopez Conde
education: MBA, NYU Stern School of Business
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an amateur developer.

technical_complexity.rationale: No-code origination workflows integrated with bank core systems, scoring and biometrics across several countries is standard enterprise engineering with integration burden.

defensibility.rationale: Once embedded in a bank's onboarding and origination flow, replacing it is costly, though bank sales cycles are long and generic vendors exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources.

market_need_then: Argentine regulators authorized fully digital onboarding (Chambers guide, undated) and an IMF paper notes fintech lending kept growing in 2020 to 2021 while bank lending slowed. YC page claims 30 clients including 7 banks in 9 countries.

branding.domain_note: Uses digitech.la and a digiventures.la email domain per a directory; no .com for Digi found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish language, short benefit focused tagline 'Mas clientes. Mas rentables.', conversion and cost focus

brand_strength.rationale: Brand search found nothing about the brand. The name Digi collides with many other companies and the older name Digiventures appears in directories.

pivots.from: Consumer platform connecting underbanked consumers to lenders (Digiventures, 2020 Berkeley article)
pivots.to: B2B SaaS for banks' loan origination and onboarding
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; the pivot date is unknown

outcome_analysis: Digi moved from a consumer lender marketplace called Digiventures to selling origination software to banks, led by two former MercadoLibre alumni with consulting backgrounds. It remains active with named bank clients such as Banco de la Nacion Argentina and case study results, though funding and traction are thinly documented. The outcome is still open.
notes: Funding unverified: Seedtable $500K seed (April 2022), Caplight $525K total, Standout $125K; no primary source so no round recorded. Competitor search found only undated aggregator lists (CB Insights lists Alprestamo and LoanWell; another source names Blend) with no dated source near the batch, so the list is left empty. Founding year is 2018 on YC and 2017 on CB Insights. The Digiventures link is inferred from a Prospeo listing, a CB Insights profile and the Berkeley article naming Pezzoni.
